# UnPredictMe

> UnPredictMe is a playful prediction experience that makes an unpredictable, fun guess about you from one tiny clue: your email address.

UnPredictMe (https://unpredictme.com) is a free web experience. Give it your email address and the prediction machine makes three unpredictable guesses: a prediction about you, something you hate, and something you'll like.

## Key facts

- What it is: a playful prediction experience, not a personality test or advice service.
- How it works: it looks at simple visible patterns in your email address — shape, length, punctuation, numbers — and turns those tiny signals into a surprising prediction.
- Predictions are generated instantly in your browser. Your email never leaves your device to make the guess.
- Predictions are entertainment, intentionally unpredictable and playful.
- Price: free.
- Maker: Annie Li, an MIT student building playful AI experiences.
- Contact: hello@unpredictme.com

## Pages

## FAQ

**What is UnPredictMe?** A playful prediction experience that makes an unpredictable, fun guess about you from one tiny clue: your email address.

**Is UnPredictMe an app?** UnPredictMe is currently a web experience at unpredictme.com — no download needed.

**How does UnPredictMe make predictions?** It looks at simple visible patterns in your email address — shape, length, punctuation, numbers — and turns those tiny signals into a surprising, playful prediction. Entertainment, not a personality test.

**Are the predictions accurate?** They are intentionally unpredictable and playful. Predictions are not facts and should not be treated as advice.

**Does UnPredictMe store my email?** The prediction is generated in your browser; your email never leaves your device to make the guess.

**Is it free?** Yes, UnPredictMe is currently free.

**Who makes UnPredictMe?** Annie Li, an MIT student building playful AI experiences.
